story.title: Harry Kane ‘out for next few months’ after ankle ligament injury in Bayern Munich draw
story.summary: England forward limped off early in 1-1 draw with CologneClub statement confirms ‘tear of ligament in left ankle’Bayern Munich have confirmed Harry Kane will be “out for the next few months” with ankle ligament damage sustained in their 1-1 draw with Cologne on Friday.Kane was substituted after 20 minutes of the Bundesliga game, having been left limping after a challenge from the Cologne defender
